# Blockulator

> Precision math for the EVM, correctly rounded and checked on chain: two
> formats, one int256 per number. FP127 is signed 127.128 fixed point, 128
> fractional bits (38 digits at 1) against 18 for the usual WAD libraries.
> FP19 is a 256-bit binary float, about 71 digits at any magnitude, to
> 10^+-78,913. Both are deployed on Ethereum Sepolia as callable contracts
> and ship as inlinable Solidity libraries. Every op is a read-only
> eth_call: no gas, no wallet, no transaction. For values above 10^-22
> agents get results more precise than a double by calling FP127, and at
> any magnitude by calling FP19.

Current release: Blockulator 3.0 (FP127 v8 + FP19 v6, ladder v13), live
on Sepolia since 2026-10-28, every address in
/contracts/deployments/RELEASE.json. CLZ required: the 3.0 contracts are
evmVersion osaka builds using the CLZ opcode (EIP-7939); they run on
Ethereum, Sepolia, Arbitrum, OP, Base, Unichain, Polygon PoS, BNB Chain,
Gnosis and other chains with CLZ, not on zkSync Era, Avalanche C-Chain or
Polygon zkEVM. Blockulator 2.2 (FP127 v6, FP19 v5, ladder v11), 2.1
(FP127 v5, FP19 v4, ladder v9) and 2.0 (FP127 v4, FP19 v3) stay live on
Sepolia, as does FP127 v7 (0xb97E0b824d86470BfAA52fe44f09363755d52591,
2026-10-27), superseded by v8 before mainnet.

## What it is

- FP19 (/library/fp19/), v6, a 256-bit binary float: sign bit 255, a
  19-bit biased exponent (bias 262143) in bits 254..236, a 236-bit fraction
  with an implicit one; about 71 digits at any magnitude, to 10^+-78,913; no
  NaN, infinity or subnormals (invalid words revert OutOfRange). 65 ops,
  each correctly rounded or exact (0 misrounded on the release sweep), in
  five objects by idea, live on Sepolia since 2026-10-28 (the same CREATE2
  proxy, Sourcify and Blockscout verified): FP19 at
  0x94d9d43D6202827429a8058959eeCf6d232b8729 (salt "FP19 v6": the
  number: add, sub, mul, div, inv, sqrt, cbrt, hypot, gavg, neg, abs,
  sign, cmp, lt, eq, min, max, clamp, floor, ceil, round, frac, avg, dist,
  zeroFloorSub, lerp, factorial (n <= 170), the edge (mulDown, mulUp,
  divDown, divUp, toUintDown, toUintUp, toIntDown, toIntUp, toFixed18Down,
  toFixed18Up, fromUintDown, fromUintUp) and the conversions), FP19E at
  0x8e5eE786bDD7c35a2867Fd329441d0BD0fB61092 (salt "FP19E v6": exp, exp2,
  exp10, expm1, ln, log2, log10, log2Up, log1p, pow, powu, compound),
  FP19H at 0xF059611C1c42543DE6EE82353Eb082Fd8999081f (salt "FP19H v6":
  sinh, cosh, tanh, atanh), FP19N at
  0xCe9F09D646B37a9100F05ED1FFD14E9f43180214 (salt "FP19N v6": erf, erfc,
  normCdf) and FP19S at 0xf74ba90535224870830e6e89D2b328d4cc09DE48 (salt
  "FP19S v6": lambertW0, lambertWm1). pi is the constant FP19Lib.PI. Ops
  table (with each op's object) /data/fp19/ops.json, FP19's ABI
  /data/fp19/abi.json, record /data/fp19/fp19.json and
  /contracts/deployments/FP19.md. FP19 v5 (Blockulator 2.2: FP19, FP19E,
  FP19H, FP19S at 0xAa1f71B7B08d568379b28E1488c6B737a1C6eb52,
  0x017F68A57dD53a6dF2043c24B712b287F9549AE2,
  0xEfefa2B63A173d56F9db79C5dd8A607F4aA859A5,
  0x73E8809F163d4358773cc5F25c134997B4b842F4), FP19 v4 (Blockulator 2.1:
  FP19, FP19X, FP19X2, FP19X3 at 0xA3C8C8700465F9e20Ff9dfA64066c2EF693Aa6c9,
  0x175246B258Cc0dC3efEFe74b5fac8cC52C0c40d0,
  0xE655bB8b1Cf848cAf3FD69F381289d144f5Bc697,
  0x59D51481cb2EA924EC17FE263cd05b90CEF22383) and FP19 v3 (Blockulator 2.0, 28
  ops, salt "FP256 v3", 0x67eFfb11bF93c79a2B12cc7872cBaC12b3eB61be) stay live.
- FP127, 53 operations: add, sub, mul, div, fromFixed18, toFixed18, exp, exp2,
  exp10, ln, log2, log10, log2Up, sqrt, cbrt, pow, powu, compound, gavg,
  hypot, inv, abs, neg, sign, min, max, clamp, avg, zeroFloorSub, dist, lerp,
  floor, ceil, frac, round, factorial, lambertW0, lambertWm1,
  log1p, expm1, sinh, cosh, tanh, atanh, erf, erfc, normCdf (the standard
  normal distribution function, the N(d) of Black-Scholes), and the
  directed mulUp, mulDown, divUp, divDown, toFixed18Up, toFixed18Down. pi
  is the constant FP127Lib.PI (the word nearest pi); gcd was removed in
  v6.
- FP127 encoding: every operand and result is an int256 holding value * 2**128.
  Decode by dividing by 2**128. Range about +/- 1.7e38.
- Checked arithmetic: out-of-domain inputs revert with Overflow(),
  DivisionByZero() or OutOfRange(). Nothing wraps.
- Validated against mpmath at 200 decimal places: add, sub, the
  comparisons and floor, ceil, round, factorial exact; mul and sqrt round down and div toward zero, within
  one ULP; every transcendental (exp, ln, pow, cbrt, Lambert W, erf, ...)
  the nearest word, within half an ULP at every committed vector and on
  1,500 to 4,000 random inputs per op, pow at extreme exponents excepted.
  exp(ln(x)) returns the same word for 10,000 steps.
  /data/precision.json
- Machine-readable op table (signature, selector, domain, reverts):
  /data/ops.json

## How to call it

- Network: Ethereum Sepolia, chainId 11155111
- RPC: https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com
- FP127: 0x466eCEde5Dc25189AD9ED999d0B4D41Cb022510B (CREATE2 through
  0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C, salt "FP127 v8"; record at
  /contracts/deployments/FP127.md and /data/fp127.json)
- ABI: /data/abi.json. All functions are pure; selectors are in /data/ops.json.
- Example: sqrt(2) is `sqrt(int256)` with 2 * 2**128 =
  680564733841876926926749214863536422912; the result divided by 2**128 is
  1.41421356...
- Inline form: contracts/src/fp127/FP127Lib.sol in the repository,
  `forge install securedataresearch/blockulator`, remapping
  fp127/=lib/blockulator/contracts/src/fp127/.
- Manifest with the same data: /.well-known/agent.json

## The precision claim, as data

- /data/ladder.json: fourteen iterated scenarios (daily compounding, an
  amortising loan, exp(ln(x)) round trips, ...), 98 inputs in all, through
  FP127, FP127Lib, ABDKMath64x64, Solady, PRBMath, ABDKMathQuad, Balancer,
  Aave, Morpho, Maker, FraxLend, Euler v2 and FP19 for N in 1..10000.
  Every cell carries the decoded value, correct significant digits against
  the exact truth (digits) and against the truth from the parameters as the
  library received them (digitsFormat, the arithmetic alone), the signed
  error in ULPs, and gas per step; summaries give median and range over the
  inputs; the methodology key says how each number is defined. Daily
  compounding, reference input, N = 365: FP127 36 digits (40 against the
  format truth), Solady and PRBMath 16, ABDK 17.
- Any FP127 or FP19 cell can be re-run on chain against the deployed
  release (FP127 v8, FP19 v6): LadderRunner at
  0xCbD62BdD4Fdd66EA814198B3B7804Cfab80e170C (salt "FP127 ladder v13"),
  run(uint8 scenario, uint8 form, uint32 n, int256[] p) returns (bool ok,
  int256 raw, bytes4 reason, uint256 gasPerStep, uint256 gasTotal), with p
  the input's floored parameters from /data/ladder-inputs.json; form 0 is
  FP127 and form 10 FP19, and the other forms' slots are empty (the other
  libraries run locally; ladder v11's runner at
  0x08b06D93620e7B33cD2d600118a75B45EF779Cec still runs 2.2's eleven forms). Scenario
  ids are in /data/scenarios.json; the record is
  /contracts/deployments/Ladder.md.
- /data/gas.json: gas per op and form, min/median/max.

## Pages

- /data/edges.json: 139 one-shot probes at the ends of each domain (ln near
  one, exp at both ends, tiny roots and products, per-second rates to a
  power, both Lambert branches, erf/erfc/normCdf) through ten libraries,
  each cell with its digits or how the library had no answer (zero below
  its floor, revert, out of range, unsupported); /results/edges/ renders it;
  any FP127 or FP19 cell re-runs through EdgeRunner.run(uint8 op, uint8 form, int256[] args)
  at 0x05A77934179b701EE2a093bAd83497765ED20d91 (selector 0xf833b7d5) with
  the arguments from /data/edge-inputs.json.
- /results/ the headline numbers, /results/ladder/ the ladder, /results/edges/ the cliffs,
  /results/ops/ gas and precision per op, /library/ address, ABI and the op table,
  /library/integrating/ the two integration rules with worked code,
  /why/ the mechanism, /writeup/ the story.

## Notes for agents

- Reads are free and need no key; do not send transactions for math.
- Sepolia only today; there is no mainnet address yet.
- The Vyper calculators listed in /.well-known/agent.json with
  "status": "archived", and the games and futures market on /archive/,
  are from the Huff era, do not call FP127 and are not maintained. Use the
  FP127 contract above.
